earlier_scan.source_named: Chia, Agnes Fiensong S. 1993. Phonology of Bubia. MA thesis, Universite de Yaounde I (MPG handle not reachable by automated download); also Nyindem 2020 (Koppe, print only)

sources.citation: Fokou Tamofo, Félix. 2002. Esquisse phonologique et principes orthographiques du Wumboko. Maîtrise dissertation, Université de Yaoundé I. iv+97 pp.
sources.access_detail: a digital copy (available on request); access check: open copy online
sources.note: Nothing on stress/accent. §1.1 Les tons (pp. 17-20): Wumboko has four tonemes, two 'ponctuels' (haut, bas) and two 'mélodiques' (montant BH, descendant HB), which are 'les quatre unités suprasegmentales' of the language; conclusion p.89 repeats that the suprasegmental group consists of the four tones. No occurrence of 'accent', 'intensité' (outside a quoted definition) or 'stress'.
sources.venue: Maîtrise dissertation, Université de Yaoundé I. iv+97 pp

sources.citation: Chia, Agnes Fiensong S. 1993. Phonology of Bubia. Maîtrise (Post-Graduate Diploma) dissertation, Université de Yaoundé I. ix+111 pp.
sources.access_detail: a digital copy (available on request); access check: open copy online
sources.note: Nothing. Chapter V 'Supra-segmental Phonology' (pp. 81-95) treats only vowel length and tone; p.81 says the discussion is limited 'to the distinctive function of certain important features like vowel length and tones'; p.82-83: Bubia has two register tones, high and low (plus downdrift, syntactic tone). The words 'stress' and 'accent' do not occur anywhere in the text (only 'louder' inside a quoted Roach syllable definition, p.69-70).
sources.venue: Maîtrise (Post-Graduate Diploma) dissertation, Université de Yaoundé I. ix+111 pp
